summary: This document is a resume for Prakhar Praveen, a Software Development Engineer at Amazon. It details his work experience, projects, skills, and education. His experience at Amazon includes architecting a rule-authoring platform, engineering a Java library to reduce latency, optimizing system efficiency, automating deployment lifecycles, and designing event-driven microservices. He also has experience as a Graduate Teaching Assistant at Arizona State University. His projects include a Psychometric Intake Engine, a Movie Recommender System, Language & POS Tag Models, and participation in a Software Security CTF. His skills encompass various programming languages, backend technologies, distributed systems, cloud platforms, data & ML, and quality/DevEx practices. He holds a Master of Science and a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Arizona State University.
